# The awareness ladder — unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware, vendor-…

`sales.df.market_research.market_awareness_stages` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> The awareness ladder — unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware, vendor-aware, most-aware — applied to the segment rather than to the individual.
